title: Roswell Mill

buildingCutout.basis: Replace the mapped two-storey Machine Shop while preserving the terrain around the separate mill remains.

terrainReference.basis: Original USGS elevation just uphill of the surviving brick machine shop.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap machine shop, overlook controls and historic dam, City of Roswell and National Park Service site descriptions.
mapIdentity.scope: Named machine shop way 345809282 matches the Old Mill Park address. Surveyed radii follow the local footprint, native mill dam line 1322314936, mapped modern overlook and unaltered USGS local elevations. The extant ruined walls are interpreted from two Qualla photos.

note: The City of Roswell documents the 1853 Machine Shop as the extant two-storey mill company building, separately from the nearby 1850s factory ruins and water-power dam. The official walking guide reports the historical dam at approximately 30 feet.
